name: genius-pos
description: Genius POS — till, stock and double-entry books for Ugandan shops

scripts.install:all: cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis portable --x64
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:bundle: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
